jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Growth)
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there's one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games.
Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

If this excites you, keep reading!

What You'll Be Doing

Design, build, and scale the recommendation systems that connect new users to communities and content, from candidate generation and ranking through to online serving.
Solve cold-start personalization for users with little or no history on Discord, turning the limited signals available into recommendations for servers, communities, and content.
Build and deploy ML models that lift new-user retention, combining purpose-built approaches with shared foundations such as user and server embeddings.
Collaborate cross-functionally to shape the Onboarding roadmap, balancing fast learning experiments with the long-term complexity and scalability of the systems behind them

5+ years of experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, or Applied Science, with a track record of shipping recommendation or personalization systems end to end.
Hands-on experience building modern recommendation systems: retrieval and ranking pipelines, embedding-based retrieval (e.g. two-tower models), and deep learning models (e.g. transformers, multi-task learning).
Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.
Experience taking ML systems from ideation to production at scale, including feature pipelines, model serving, monitoring, and online experimentation.
Strong product intuition and a passion for building 0→1 ML applications grounded in user feedback and real-world impact.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, able to serve as the ML voice on a cross-functional squad and keep stakeholders aligned on trade-offs, priorities, and progress.
The ability to thrive in ambiguous environments, energized by tackling open-ended, technically challenging problems

Bonus Points If You Have:

Experience with cold-start or new-user personalization, onboarding flows, or preference elicitation.
Built user representation models or applied social-graph signals to recommendation problems.
Worked on growth or engagement problems for consumer products, such as community and content recommendations, user activation, or retention.
Experience with large-scale recommendation systems, data infrastructure, distributed computing, and vector search.

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. Office of the Managing Director and Chief Knowledge Officer

The office plays a key role in shaping the WBG's strategic direction, supporting key partnerships with shareholders, development agen-cies, academia, and other stakeholders, and strengthening how knowledge, evidence, and learning inform de-velopment impact. The Knowledge Bank is intended to bring global expertise closer to country challenges, strengthen collaboration across sectors and institutions, and help scale practical solutions that can improve lives, create jobs, and sup-port better development outcomes.

As part of this model, the WBG now operates through five vertical vice presidencies aligned with the mission: People, Prosperity, Planet, Infrastructure, and Digital & AI. In addition, three horizontal departments report-ing to the MDCKO enhance knowledge, innovation, and outcome orientation across the WBG. One of those horizontal departments focuses on improving the institution's outcome orientation: the Department for Out-comes.

About The Department For Outcomes

The Department for Outcomes is a corporate delivery and change team at the center of the World Bank Group's shift from measuring activity to managing for impact. Its mandate is to make outcomes visible, com-parable, and actionable so that leaders and teams can understand where the institution is changing lives, where progress is off track, and what needs to change next.

The Department leads the implementation of the World Bank Group Scorecard as an accountability, manage-ment, and communications tool. Its work reaches from project-level data to sen-ior management decisions, and from new methodologies inside the World Bank Group to shared approaches across the international development system.

Technology and innovation are core to how the team works. The Department develops AI-enabled analytics, data pipelines, forecasting models, interactive visualizations, and decision-support products that turn large and complex datasets into clear choices for operational teams, senior management, and external stakeholders. A piece of analysis is not considered finished when it is technically correct; it is finished when it helps im-prove a decision, a process, or a development outcome.

The culture is entrepreneurial, collaborative, and demanding. The team moves quickly because the needs are urgent, tests ideas early, learns from users, improves continuously, and expects high standards from concept through delivery. It values intellectual curiosity, rigorous analysis, direct communication, ownership, thoughtful risk-taking, and the readiness to challenge established practices. This includes end-to-end data collection, data cleaning, exploratory analysis, and rigorous quality assurance of WBG Scorecard indicators, as well as conducting manual and automated reviews of results frameworks in operational pro-ject documents (e.g., Project Appraisal Documents [PADs], Implementation Status and Results Reports [ISRs], and Implementation Completion and Results Reports [ICRs]) when required.

Portfolio Analytics & Strategic Executive Insights: Analyze outcome metrics from across WBG opera-tions, aggregate portfolio results, and monitor where and how the institution is delivering on its develop-ment commitments. Executive Visualization & Strategic Communication: Translate complex, multidimensional analytical and econometric findings into clear, visually compelling, and consulting-style deliverables. jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents, like our own Apollo, take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers’ business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: data pipelines, user facing applications, initial value realization, adoption, and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead Deployment Architect - AI, you are the most senior technical authority within delivery. You own the end-to-end solution architecture for your portfolio of strategic customer engagements - from data foundation through process intelligence, operational apps, automation, and the governance that keeps it all running in production. You define what good delivery looks like, set the architectural standards other teams follow, and stay hands-on enough to prove them.

The majority of your work is designing and delivering robust, scalable enterprise solutions end to end: data integration and data strategy, solution (end-user application) design, security and user access, change management, and the operational discipline that sustains value after go-live. AI-augmented delivery is woven throughout - you are fluent in directing agentic tooling and you orchestrate it to move faster and smarter - but your value is the architecture, the judgment, and customers’ trust.

You are equally comfortable leading a technical design review with Celonis Deployment Engineers and presenting a transformation roadmap to a customer’s senior leadership. You bridge pre-sales and post-sales, scoping and estimating effort before a deal closes and ensuring that what was promised can be delivered - and often shaping the promise itself. You carry significant organizational influence: you set delivery patterns, resolve escalations on complex engagements, and raise the bar for the entire practice.

As a member of our Advanced AI Practice, you are a Deployment Architect first and an AI specialist second. Every Deployment Architect brings AI into their solutions; you are the person who knows when a problem calls for a machine learning model or an AI system that acts on its own, which approach fits, and how to prove it works before a customer relies on it. On our most complex engagements you work alongside a Deployment Architect: they lead the business questions and the overall architecture, while you decide which parts of the solution run on fixed business rules, which on AI reasoning or predictions, and how each part is tested and monitored in production. Where AI is the core of the solution, you lead the architecture yourself. You belong to both our Deployment Architect Practice and a global community of Advanced AI specialists, and you help set the standards and patterns the rest of Celonis Services builds on.

The Work You’ll Do

Platform Architecture & Design

Own end-to-end platform architecture for complex enterprise deployments spanning multiple process areas, business units, systems, and geographies.
Define the technical blueprint for how the Celonis platform integrates with customer systems and data strategies - designing secure, scalable architectures optimized for long-term usage growth, high concurrency, and maintainability.
Make and defend architectural trade-off decisions - build vs. configure, custom vs. standard, phased vs. big-bang - with clear rationale tied to customer outcomes.
Own solution quality across engagements, conducting design and code reviews and ensuring delivery teams follow architectural standards through to production readiness.

Delivery Leadership & Scoping

Lead delivery end to end on your most complex engagements, setting technical direction and making the calls that remove dependencies and resolve escalations against timeline, scope, and customer expectations.
Support pre-sales by scoping Services, estimating effort, and validating solution feasibility - ensuring the right Services are positioned in line with the proposed solution architecture, and that what is sold can be delivered and scaled in production.
Stay hands-on with the newest Celonis capabilities, owning the implementation of early-stage products for customers and maintaining close feedback cycles with Product & Engineering.
Govern the solution for the long run, defining the operating model: monitoring, access and security controls, change management, and how quality holds as the solution scales.

Customer Strategy & Advisory

Serve as the senior technical advisor to strategic customers, building trusted relationships with VP-level and above executives at some of the world’s largest companies, and with their senior technology leaders (e.g., Lead Data Engineers, Enterprise Architects, Heads of Business Transformation).
Translate business challenges into platform strategies, identifying high-impact use cases, defining success metrics, and framing the value case in outcomes, not features.
Guide customers through their Process Intelligence maturity journey, advising on platform expansion, IT change management, data security, AI readiness, and organizational change, and bringing in the broader ecosystem of Celonis experts to take each delivery to the next level.

Domain & Industry Depth

Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals.
Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices the broader team can reuse, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap.

Advanced AI Practice Development

Mentor Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects on AI solution design, model evaluation, and production guardrails through design and code reviews, and help them grow toward Advanced AI roles.
Contribute to hiring: define what great looks like for Advanced AI roles in the Deployment job family, conduct interviews, and calibrate candidate assessments.
Give back to the Advanced AI Practice alongside client work: turn one-off AI builds into reusable templates, host open office hours, and help close known AI gaps across Celonis Services.
Feed lessons from production AI deployments back to Product & Engineering for native platform feature development, including our internal AI delivery tooling.

The Qualifications You Need

Experience: 8+ years in technical consulting, forward deployed engineering, solution / enterprise architecture, or delivery leadership within enterprise software, consulting firms, or system integrators - including at least 3 years in a senior or lead technical role with multi-stakeholder responsibility on large-scale enterprise projects.
Architecture skills: Proven ability to design and deliver complex, end-to-end enterprise solutions spanning data integration, process intelligence, operational apps, and automation - grounded in the “art of the possible” of a customer’s process. Deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns, security and governance, and trade-offs.
Technical Skills: Deep and demonstrable knowledge of SQL, Python, Bash / Shell scripting and use of REST / SOAP APIs. Familiarity with other general purpose programming languages (e.g. Golang, Javascript / Typescript, Java, or equivalent).
Platform mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the Celonis platform, including the Process Intelligence Graph, data modeling, advanced PQL, Python scripting, and the automation and orchestration engine. Ability to push the platform’s boundaries.
AI solution architecture: You design solutions that combine fixed business rules, AI reasoning (e.g., large language models), predictive and statistical models, and optimization, and you can explain why each part of the solution uses the approach it does. You direct AI-assisted and agentic development tools (e.g., Apollo, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) as part of day-to-day delivery.
Production AI delivery: You have taken machine learning and/or statistical models into production for customers or business users, or designed and delivered an end-to-end agentic system that takes actions on its own. In either case, you chose the approach, defined how to measure whether it was right, and built the guardrails and monitoring that catch it when it isn’t. (A degree in ML, statistics, data science, or a related quantitative field is a plus, but is not required.)
Customer executive presence: Track record of building trusted advisor relationships with senior stakeholders, presenting transformation strategies, defending architectural decisions, and navigating complex IT landscapes and organizational dynamics.
Delivery & consulting leadership: Experience owning technical delivery and escalations end to end, scoping and estimating effort in pre-sales, and leading workshops, design sessions, and strategic reviews with senior stakeholders.
Leadership & mentoring: Demonstrated ability to raise the performance of the teams around you - mentoring technical staff, setting quality standards, and contributing to organizational capability. (Formal people-management experience is a plus, but not a requirement.)

jobs.title: Principal Applied Scientist, Fauna
jobs.description:
Description

Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life, and understanding where it is, and what's around it, is fundamental to everything a robot does. A robot that lives alongside people must build and maintain a map of its environment, plan paths through cluttered and changing spaces, and do so reliably whether it's navigating a hallway for the hundredth time or entering a room it has never seen. We are hiring a Principal Applied Scientist to serve as a technical authority on how our robots understand and move through the world.

You will design, prototype, and ship the core algorithms that give the robot spatial intelligence - from real-time SLAM and scene understanding to motion planning and autonomous navigation. You will set the mapping and navigation architecture that other engineers build on, shape sensor and compute decisions across robot generations, mentor the engineers and scientists working on spatial perception, and be the person teams come to when the robot is lost.

Key job responsibilities

Set the long-range science roadmap and technical architecture for the robot's mapping, localization, and navigation stack, and serve as Fauna's primary technical authority on spatial intelligence
Design and implement real-time visual-inertial and/or lidar-based SLAM systems that build, update, and maintain persistent maps of home and indoor environments

Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. Office of the Managing Director and Chief Knowledge Officer

With the launch of the Knowledge Bank at the start of 2026, the WBG is deepening its fo-cus on one of the areas client countries value most: global knowledge on what works, where, and why. The Knowledge Bank is intended to bring global expertise closer to country challenges, strengthen collaboration across sectors and institutions, and help scale practical solutions that can improve lives, create jobs, and sup-port better development outcomes.

As part of this model, the WBG now operates through five vertical vice presidencies aligned with the mission: People, Prosperity, Planet, Infrastructure, and Digital & AI. In addition, three horizontal departments report-ing to the MDCKO enhance knowledge, innovation, and outcome orientation across the WBG. One of those horizontal departments focuses on improving the institution's outcome orientation: the Department for Out-comes.

About The Department For Outcomes

The Department for Outcomes is a corporate delivery and change team at the center of the World Bank Group's shift from measuring activity to managing for impact. Its mandate is to make outcomes visible, com-parable, and actionable so that leaders and teams can understand where the institution is changing lives, where progress is off track, and what needs to change next.

The Department leads the implementation of the World Bank Group Scorecard as an accountability, manage-ment, and communications tool. It develops and improves outcome indicators, methodologies, and targets in areas such as jobs, climate, private capital, gender, and youth; provides quality assurance; and connects out-come ambitions to knowledge, operations, and financing. Through its Outcome Measurement and Outcome Delivery units, the Department combines corporate reporting with portfolio analytics, forecasting, regular stocktakes, and action planning across the World Bank, IFC, and MIGA.

The Department also has a growing global role. It convenes multilateral development banks, development agencies, researchers, and external experts to improve and align outcome approaches, build institutional ca-pacity, and modernize the profession of results measurement. Its work reaches from project-level data to sen-ior management decisions, and from new methodologies inside the World Bank Group to shared approaches across the international development system.

Technology and innovation are core to how the team works. The Department develops AI-enabled analytics, data pipelines, forecasting models, interactive visualizations, and decision-support products that turn large and complex datasets into clear choices for operational teams, senior management, and external stakeholders. A piece of analysis is not considered finished when it is technically correct; it is finished when it helps im-prove a decision, a process, or a development outcome.

The culture is entrepreneurial, collaborative, and demanding. The team moves quickly because the needs are urgent, tests ideas early, learns from users, improves continuously, and expects high standards from concept through delivery. You define what good delivery looks like, set the architectural standards other teams follow, and stay hands-on enough to prove them.

The majority of your work is designing and delivering robust, scalable enterprise solutions end to end: data integration and data strategy, solution (end-user application) design, security and user access, change management, and the operational discipline that sustains value after go-live. AI-augmented delivery is woven throughout - you are fluent in directing agentic tooling and you orchestrate it to move faster and smarter - but your value is the architecture, the judgment, and customers’ trust.

You are equally comfortable leading a technical design review with Celonis Deployment Engineers and presenting a transformation roadmap to a customer’s senior leadership. As a member of our Advanced AI Practice, you are a Deployment Architect first and an AI specialist second. Every Deployment Architect brings AI into their solutions; you are the person who knows when a problem calls for a machine learning model or an AI system that acts on its own, which approach fits, and how to prove it works before a customer relies on it. On our most complex engagements you work alongside a Deployment Architect: they lead the business questions and the overall architecture, while you decide which parts of the solution run on fixed business rules, which on AI reasoning or predictions, and how each part is tested and monitored in production. Where AI is the core of the solution, you lead the architecture yourself. Deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns, security and governance, and trade-offs.

Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life, and understanding where it is, and what's around it, is fundamental to everything a robot does. A robot that lives alongside people must build and maintain a map of its environment, plan paths through cluttered and changing spaces, and do so reliably whether it's navigating a hallway for the hundredth time or entering a room it has never seen. We are hiring a Principal Applied Scientist to serve as a technical authority on how our robots understand and move through the world.

You will design, prototype, and ship the core algorithms that give the robot spatial intelligence - from real-time SLAM and scene understanding to motion planning and autonomous navigation. You will set the mapping and navigation architecture that other engineers build on, shape sensor and compute decisions across robot generations, mentor the engineers and scientists working on spatial perception, and be the person teams come to when the robot is lost.

Set the long-range science roadmap and technical architecture for the robot's mapping, localization, and navigation stack, and serve as Fauna's primary technical authority on spatial intelligence
Design and implement real-time visual-inertial and/or lidar-based SLAM systems that build, update, and maintain persistent maps of home and indoor environments
Develop robust localization algorithms that allow the robot to determine its precise pose in previously mapped spaces, handling environmental changes such as moved furniture, lighting variation, and dynamic occupants
Build navigation and motion planning systems that produce safe, efficient, and natural-looking trajectories through cluttered, dynamic human spaces

new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Team Overview

The Applied AI team takes on the voice AI problems that don’t have off-the-shelf answers. We work directly with enterprise customers and technology partners, from conversational AI and customer experience platforms to restaurant brands, and much of the work is zero to one. Current focus areas include robust ASR in noisy outdoor environments, self-service fine-tuning and model adaptation, domain-aware voice agents for drive-thru and phone ordering, agent scoring and evaluation, real-time operational analytics, and on-site hardware integration. We’re a small team that works in person in San Francisco, ships to production quickly, and stays close to the customers we build for.

Key Goals

Ship production features in live voice agent products, such as drive-thru and phone ordering, within your first quarter.
Own customer problems end to end: hear the issue, find the root cause, and get the fix into production.
Help build reusable agent modules, like ordering and reservations, so new customers and industries launch faster.
Make agents more accurate on real-world menus and catalogs, keeping structured data consistent across hundreds of locations.
Contribute to fine-tuning and model adaptation so customers get accurate results on their own vocabulary and domains.
Spot problems across the product before anyone asks, then fix them or bring a proposed solution.
Run experiments that show whether new functionality improves outcomes for customers.

Minimum Skills, Knowledge & Capabilities

Experience building and shipping backend services that run in production in the cloud.
Operates AI-native: you build with modern AI coding tools as your default way of working, not occasionally, and use them to move fast without lowering the quality bar.
Learns quickly and takes on unfamiliar parts of the stack with little ramp-up.
Finds work instead of waiting for it: you recognize problems, propose solutions, and follow them through.
Has taken something from idea to production, at work or on your own time.
Communicates clearly with teammates and is comfortable working directly with customers.
Builds for the customer’s outcome, with a high bar for quality and no over-engineering.
Comfortable working across languages. Our stack is mainly Kotlin and Python, with TypeScript on the front end.

Preferred Qualifications (nice-to-have)

Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or adapting models, through work, research, or substantial projects.
Experience building evaluation or scoring for models or agents.
Experience with audio, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech.
Experience as a founder or early startup engineer, or taking a system from zero to one.
Typically 2+ years of engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.

The Cadence SSG Central Applications Engineering team is seeking a Systems Solutions Architect and Technical Lead to define compute-centric solutions for Physical AI. In this role, your primary responsibility is to define SoC subsystems for AI applications using Cadence DSPs, CPUs, NPUs, and accelerators. You will analyze the requirements of Edge AI and Physical AI applications, and optimize subsystems for power, performance, area, and software flexibility. Additionally, you will define the SoC integration and software runtime requirements for these subsystems from the perspective of boot/control, runtime data flows, security, and safety.

In this role, you will set the technical vision and architecture for the subsystems, partnering closely with hardware implementation, software engineering, and performance modeling teams. Leveraging Cadence’s Silicon Solutions Group (SSG) IP portfolio, you will implement Physical AI, Computer Vision, and Audio algorithms into deployed, real-world systems.

Responsibilities

Define and own the system architecture for new hardware subsystems (compute, memory, interconnects, interfaces) and corresponding software stack (drivers, HAL, compiler runtimes, and middleware).
Architect solutions using the entire portfolio Cadence SSG IP, including compute (Tensilica DSPs and CPUs), Accelerators (Neo NPU and application-specific), interface IP, and memory controllers.
Partner closely with dedicated Performance Modeling teams to build cycle-accurate or transaction-level (TLM) simulations of the SoC subsystem. Use performance simulation data to identify bottlenecks before committing to silicon.
Hand off clear architectural specifications to experienced RTL/Hardware Implementation teams and Software/Firmware Engineering teams and serve as the bridge between these teams to ensure alignment.
Act as the final authority during system integration, validating that the implemented software stack extracts maximum performance from the physical hardware features.
Build scalable proof-of-concept (PoC) and reference designs that demonstrate the capabilities of the integrated Cadence IP platform.
Act as the technical liaison with Cadence engineering partners to influence future IP roadmaps based on emerging Physical AI trends (e.g., robotics, autonomous systems, edge transformers).

Required Skills

12+ years in a leading architectural or system engineering role, with a demonstrable history of architecting complex systems from concept through to production.
Proven track record of designing integrated solutions where hardware features are explicitly built to support software mechanics, and vice versa.
Experience collaborating with, or leading performance modeling teams using SystemC, TLM, or custom cycle-accurate simulator infrastructures.
Experience in Physical AI (robotics, autonomous systems) delivering real-time Imaging and/or Radar (spatial awareness, tracking) and Advanced Audio processing.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to travel up to 10% of the time, including internationally.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description:

Location: New York, NY

Work Arrangement: Hybrid, 3 days in office

About The Role

Dentsu is seeking a Senior Vice President of Agentic Commerce Solutions to lead the development of next generation commerce technology and AI powered solutions across the enterprise.

This executive will report directly to the Head of Commerce for Dentsu North America and lead the development of agentic technology for dentsu.commerce within dentsu.connect, Dentsu’s enterprise technology platform. They will build the technical integrations, strategic partnerships and intelligent workflows that connect commerce intelligence, planning, activation and measurement.

Central to this role is advancing agentic commerce capabilities through Model Context Protocol (MCP), APIs and emerging AI architectures. Working in partnership with the EVP of Retail Media, the SVP will help shape the strategic product roadmap while owning the technical architecture, hands on development and delivery of dentsu.commerce.

The ideal candidate combines deep commerce expertise with strong software engineering experience and the ability to build, prototype and scale AI powered solutions. This leader must be equally comfortable defining technical strategy, writing code alongside engineering teams and translating emerging technologies into enterprise solutions that drive operational efficiency and measurable client growth.

Key Responsibilities

Product Development and Technology Architecture

Partner with the Head of Commerce and EVP of Retail Media to establish the strategic product roadmap and development priorities for dentsu.commerce.
Own the technical architecture and define capabilities connecting commerce intelligence, audience insights, planning, activation and measurement.
Lead the development and delivery of dentsu.commerce within dentsu.connect, ensuring alignment with enterprise technology standards.
Work directly with engineering teams to design, prototype, develop and test technical solutions, contributing hands on coding and technical problem solving where needed.
Translate business requirements into technical specifications, development plans and scalable software solutions.
Own technical execution plans, development milestones and delivery against defined business outcomes.

Agentic Commerce and MCP Integrations

Architect and build MCP based connections, APIs and integrations across Dentsu’s commerce technology ecosystem.
Develop and prototype AI agents and automated workflows that connect commerce data and intelligence directly to planning, activation, optimization and measurement.
Partner with technology providers in the commerce ecosystem to enable secure, scalable agentic capabilities.
Establish technical frameworks for agent orchestration, platform connectivity, governance and responsible AI deployment.
Evaluate code, troubleshoot integration challenges and guide engineering teams in developing production ready agentic solutions.
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and accelerate commerce decision making.

Strategic Technology Partnerships

Build senior relationships with commerce technology partners to influence integration roadmaps and identify opportunities for joint innovation.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, commerce platforms and integration frameworks through technical assessments, proof of concepts and hands on experimentation.
Collaborate with internal technology and commercial stakeholders on strategic product partnerships and investment priorities.
Identify opportunities to leverage partner capabilities to differentiate Dentsu’s commerce solutions.

Commercialization and Enterprise Growth

Translate technical capabilities into differentiated commerce products that support enterprise growth.
Partner with Commerce leadership to support product commercialization, adoption and strategic new business opportunities.
Develop business cases for technology investments, including revenue opportunities, operational efficiencies and scalability.
Establish frameworks to deploy and scale commerce solutions across clients, retailers and markets.

Qualifications And Experience

10+ years of experience in commerce technology, software engineering, digital product development, marketing technology or enterprise technology solutions.
Proven experience developing and scaling technology products within an agency, technology company or enterprise environment.
Strong hands on software development experience, ideally with Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, including experience building APIs, integrations and AI powered applications.
Demonstrated ability to write, review and troubleshoot code and develop working prototypes independently.
Strong understanding of the commerce and retail media technology ecosystem.
Demonstrated experience architecting and implementing API integrations, platform connectivity and strategic technology partnerships.
Practical experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), large language models, agentic AI architectures and AI workflow orchestration.
Experience translating technical capabilities into commercial products and scalable enterprise solutions.
Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, data science and commercial leadership teams.
Strong understanding of enterprise technology governance, data privacy and responsible AI principles.
Excellent executive communication, strategic thinking and stakeholder management skills.
Agency experience supporting enterprise commerce or retail media clients preferred.
